abstract: Forty-three patients with early stage pure seminoma of the testis were analyzed retrospectively. All patients were treated with orchiectomy and radiation therapy. Overall survival was 97.7 percent, with followup ranging from 4.3 to 17.4 years.
abstract_ja: 早期病期の純粋精巣セミノーマ患者43例について後方視的に解析した。全例に精巣摘除術と放射線療法を施行した。経過観察期間は4.3～17.4年で、全生存率は97.7%であった。
